name: qualifybase
description: Qualify leads with AI automations. Guide workspace and Instagram setup, review customer conversations and weekly insights, manage leads and appointments, and preview and save explicitly approved agent-prompt edits.

interface.longDescription: Qualify leads with AI automations from your QualifyBase workspace. Get guided account, Instagram, and agent setup; review leads, conversations, calls, campaign progress, and evidence-based weekly customer insights; manage lead records and appointments. With separate optional prompt permissions, read an agent's current instructions, preview targeted changes, and save only an explicitly approved preview. Direct saves require safe-editing enrollment and an eligible paused agent with private voice access, no inbound phone route, and finished voice sessions. A verified save backs up the original prompt, synchronizes text and voice, and preserves the greeting and unrelated settings. Uncertain saves remain blocked for dashboard repair. A QualifyBase administrator account is required. Integrations, non-prompt agent settings, billing, and live status remain dashboard actions. Available evidence depends on your connected channels and stored transcripts; capped reports disclose incomplete coverage. The plugin does not send messages, initiate calls, or launch campaigns.
capabilities: Inspect call history and campaign progress
Check calendar availability and manage appointments
Guide workspace, Instagram, and agent setup
Preview and save explicitly approved agent prompt edits
Analyze customer objections from conversation evidence
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my QualifyBase workspace and connect Instagram.
What did my leads struggle with last week?
Read my agent prompt and preview a friendlier tone while preserving its existing rules.

publication.release_notes: Adds eight workflows for setup, lead and conversation review, appointments, weekly customer insights, and safe prompt editing. Optional prompt-read and prompt-write permissions enable targeted previews and explicitly approved guarded saves. Original instructions, greeting, and unrelated settings are preserved; uncertain results require dashboard recovery. Existing connections keep their original permissions until users explicitly approve the new scopes. Explicit OAuth base scopes request the same four permissions on each new connection; prompt access still requires separate administrator consent.
